What Makes a Good Business Website in Cameroon

Many businesses in Cameroon have websites — but very few have websites that actually work for them. A good business website must meet several standards.

Mobile-first design: Over 80% of internet users in Cameroon browse on smartphones. If your website does not look great and load fast on mobile, you are losing the majority of your potential customers before they even read a word.

Fast loading speed: Slow websites kill conversions. In Cameroon where mobile data speeds vary, a website that loads in under 3 seconds performs dramatically better than one that takes 8-10 seconds.

Clear messaging: Your website should immediately communicate what you do, who you serve, and why someone should choose you over competitors. Confused visitors leave without contacting you.

Search engine optimization: A beautiful website that no one can find on Google is wasted money. From day one, your website must be built with SEO in mind — proper structure, fast loading, relevant content, and technical optimization.

Strong calls to action: Every page should guide the visitor toward the next step — calling you, filling a form, sending a WhatsApp message, or making a purchase.
